companion_space_template.target: Anime 1-Image to 8-Clips First+Last Frame Locked Loop Pack
companion_space_template.notes: Load anchor.webp into BOTH StartFrame and EndFrame inputs of your chosen First-Last-Frame I2V model (e.g. Wan2.1/2.2-FLF2V or MiniMax H3 local node). Keep seed fixed per batch, resolution 576x1024 (9:16), 24fps, 73-121 frames.

nodes.title: Anchor Image (9:16 Anime Portrait - Start & End Frame)
Positive Motion Prompt (Paste from prompts/anime-8-clips.zh-CN.md)
widgets_values: Anime 2.5D portrait, static camera, fixed framing. Gentle natural breathing, soft shoulder movement, blinking calmly twice, warm relaxed eye contact with camera, subtle hair sway, seamless loop back to start pose.

nodes.title: Negative Prompt (Anti-Drift & Clean Background)
widgets_values: blurry, lowres, deformed hands, extra fingers, face flicker, identity drift, camera zoom, camera pan, extra people in background, text, watermark, sudden cut

nodes.title: Connect Your Local FLF2V / I2V Model Node Here
widgets_values:
Plug Node 2 (576x1024 Anchor) into BOTH start_image and end_image of your installed First-Last-Frame Video node (such as WanFirstLastFrameToVideo or MiniMax H3 All-In-One Reference).

Recommended settings:
- 8 GB VRAM (RTX 5060): Q4/FP8 quantized weights, 576x1024, 73 frames (3s) or 97 frames (4s), 24fps, CPU offload enabled.
- 16 GB VRAM (RTX 5060Ti): FP8/BF16, 720x1280, 97-121 frames, 24fps.

nodes.title: Export & Pack Step
widgets_values:
Save each generated clip into clips/<slot>.mp4 or .webm:
- idle_breathe, listen_nod, think_chin, speak_explain_a, speak_explain_b, board_point, react_praise, react_comfort

Then run:
python tools/tutorpack/cli.py pack ./your-pack -o tutor.tutorpack
